bullets_en: Telangana Police release Rs 5.59 crore in pending rewards to 214 surrendered Maoist cadres.
Boost to Atmanirbhar Bharat, India tests JWALA MK-1 counter-drone missile system.
Death toll rises after Russian attacks on Ukraine.
From weapons deals to military drills, how India and US deepened defence ties in 2026.
SOT raids illegal poker den in lalaguda, arrests 25 persons.
bullets_ur: Telangana Police ne hathyar dalne wale 214 Maoist karkunon ke liye Rs 5.59 crore ke inaamat jari kar diye.
Atmanirbhar Bharat ko taqwiyat, India ne JWALA MK-1 drone mukhalif missile system ka kamyab tajarba kiya.
Ukraine par Russian hamlon ke baad halakaton ki tadad mein izafa ho gaya.
Aslahay ke muahidon se fauji mashqon tak, 2026 mein India aur US ne difaee talluqat mazboot kiye.
